lead.purpose: Section introductions in Soft Graphite, max 36em.

body.purpose: Running text; list descriptions and FAQ answers at 15.5px in Soft Graphite.

label.purpose: Captions, meta line, tags and footer in Dim Graphite (12.5 to 13.5px).

shadows.name: lit-top-edge
shadows.purpose: The screenshot frame's top edge catching light.

shadows.name: outline
shadows.purpose: Tray-icon tiles and the real screenshot.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared curve for all transitions and the hero settle.

motion.purpose: Hover, press and color transitions; 0.3s for nav border and FAQ chevron.

motion.value: 1.2s ease-out 0.15s both; from translateY(28px) scale(0.985) blur(6px) opacity 0.4 to rest
motion.purpose: The single authored motion, hero screenshot only, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

narrative.overview:
A dark desk at night with one lit object on it: the real 几格 interface. The site is the category-standard product page played straight at Linear's level of craft: one promise, one white download button, the real panel as the hero, and everything else quiet enough that the product's own battery colors are the only color that registers. The world is near-black and tonal, drawn with white hairlines instead of boxes, set in the visitor's own system CJK sans, and almost entirely still.

Density is calm and readable for non-programmers browsing in Chinese: generous section breathing room, short plain lines, lists that read as rows of facts rather than marketing tiles. Proof is never illustrated. Every image of the product is a crop of the UI prototype the app is drawn from, or a real Windows screenshot, and is captioned as such.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal layering (ground, raised) plus 8% / 14% white hairlines; no card grids.
One cool accent, reserved for links, focus and selection.
Battery state color (yellow, red, green) lives only inside product imagery.
System font stacks only; no hosted or third-party resources of any kind.
One authored motion: the hero screenshot settles in once.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Battery-Cell Blue appears only on links, focus and selection. If it is filling an area or coloring a heading, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Color Lives in the Product Rule
rules.body: Yellow, red and green battery states appear only inside product screenshots. Site chrome never re-draws them as badges, charts or decoration. The only non-neutral chrome color besides the accent is Verified Green on the verification tag.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: No hosted fonts, no webfont files, no CDN. Type comes from the visitor's OS stack; Microsoft YaHei UI is the expected Windows CJK face.

rules.name: The Unbroken Phrase Rule
rules.body: Chinese sublines are split into phrase spans that don't break internally, and headings use balanced wrapping, so a line never ends on an orphaned character.

rules.name: The Native Size Rule
rules.body: Product screenshots are shown at native size or larger (2x WebP sources), never shrunk until their text is unreadable. On narrow screens crop, don't scale down.

rules.name: The Only Lit Object Rule
rules.body: Only product screenshots float and catch light. Text blocks, lists and sections never get shadows or raised panels.

dos: Do keep the page dark-only on Night Ground with Raised Slate as the only surface step.
Do separate content with 8% white hairlines and open rows; reach for a list before a card.
Do use Battery-Cell Blue only for links, the focus ring and selection.

Do show the product only as the real interface: crops of design/ui-claude.html rendered at 2x, or real Windows screenshots, each captioned 界面原型 / 演示数据 or 实机截图, each raster carrying a provenance sidecar JSON.
Do frame product screenshots with the 12px frame, float shadow and lit top edge.
Do use system CJK font stacks and tabular numerals.
Do keep the hero settle as the single authored motion; state transitions stay at 0.2 to 0.3s and respect reduced motion.
Do keep every script and style in self-hosted files so the strict CSP holds (`script-src 'self'`, `style-src 'self'`).
donts: Don't draw or mock up UI, icons-as-product or fake panels; if it isn't a crop of the prototype or a real screenshot, it doesn't ship.
Don't use battery yellow, red or green in site chrome, badges or illustrations.
Don't build equal icon-card rows or feature-tile grids.
Don't load hosted fonts, CDNs, analytics, embeds or any third-party resource; visitors are in China.
Don't write inline `<script>`, inline `style` attributes or `<style>` blocks.
Don't add a second animated element, scroll-triggered reveals or parallax.
Don't shrink screenshots below native size to fit a layout; crop instead.
